modules.title: Access REST services from within Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Learn how to use HTTP data types, connect to external REST services, and handle JSON data in Dynamics 365 Business Central.

modules.title: Add a layout to a report in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to learn how to add a layout to a report in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central? In this module, you'll learn about the client report definition (RDLC) layout and Word layout formats and how to create them.

modules.title: Add new objects to Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to know how to add objects, like tables and pages, to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central? If so, this module is for you. In this module, you'll learn how to create tables and pages for an extension.

modules.title: Add reports to Tell Me and substitute a report in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to learn how to add reports to Tell Me and substitute a report in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central? In this module, you'll learn how to add reports to Tell Me and how to substitute a report.

modules.title: Work with AL built-in functions in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to know more about the built-in programming functions of Business Central? This module will discuss the different available functions that you can use when developing for Business Central.

modules.title: Learn the AL statements in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to know how to use basic AL statements? This module shows you how to use conditional statements, compound statements, and comments when developing for Business Central.

modules.title: Consider application monetization responsibilities in Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to understand your application monetization responsibilities? In this module, you'll learn about monetization responsibilities, and where to find useful guides and documentation.

modules.title: Learn about application performance and monitoring in Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to learn about application performance and monitoring? Learn what is required to write performant code, understand how you can monitor application performance, and get required insights.

modules.title: Introduction to application types in Business Central
modules.summary: Explore the differences between connect and addon applications, understand library and dependency apps, and learn app development resources in Business Central.

modules.title: Introduction to assisted setup and tooltips in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to know an effective way to let a user perform the installation steps of your extension by using an efficient and accessible wizard in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central? If so, this module is for you. In this module, you'll learn how to add a wizard page by using a navigate page object.

modules.title: Understand the process of bringing an app to AppSource in Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to know about technical and marketing AppSource validation procedures? In this module, you'll learn what is required from a technical and marketing point of view for your application to be validated for AppSource.

modules.title: Build an Assisted Setup in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Assisted Setup guides you in configuring Business Central. Do you want to learn how you can integrate with the Assisted Setup feature and create your own wizard pages? If so, this module explains that process.

modules.title: Build control add-in objects in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you need to build control add-ins? This module discusses how to build and integrate control add-ins with JavaScript in AL.

modules.title: Build a Power BI report with Business Central data
modules.summary: Do you want to build a Business Central report using Power BI Desktop? This module will guide you through the steps required to create a Power BI report.

modules.title: Integrate Dynamics 365 Business Central with Teams
modules.summary: Learn to integrate Dynamics 365 Business Central with Microsoft Teams.

modules.title: Complete the report request page in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to learn how to complete the report request page for a report in Business Central? In this module, you'll learn about the report request page and how to create it.

modules.title: Create a canvas app based on Business Central data
modules.summary: Do you want to create a canvas app using Business Central data? This module focuses on how to create canvas app using Business Central data and how to customize the created app.

modules.title: Create a custom connector to extend Microsoft Power Platform functionalities with Business Central
modules.summary: Do you need to create custom connectors for Business Central? Use this module to find out the details of creating custom connectors.

modules.title: Create custom procedures in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to create custom procedures in AL? This module focuses on explaining how you can create new procedures. Additionally, it describes the difference between local and global procedures, the difference between local and global variables, and how you can pass variables to a procedure.

modules.title: Create a dataset for a Power BI report in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Learn how to create a dataset for a Power BI report in Business Central using assisted reporting setup and custom data sets.

modules.title: Customize the UI experience in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to further customize the UI experience for a user? Do you want to be able to add your pages and reports to the search functionality? In this module, you'll learn how to create page customizations for specific user profiles and extend the application areas.

modules.title: Debug and deploy your extension in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Discover how to debug with Visual Studio Code and deploy your extension using RAD feature in Dynamics 365 Business Central.

modules.title: Design the data model of a report in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to learn how to build the data model for a report in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central? This module will discuss the different components of a report data model.

modules.title: Develop a Role Center in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Create a Role Center page for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and learn how it's constructed.

modules.title: Prepare for an easy application upgrade experience in Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to learn about how to build efficient installation and upgrade procedures? There are essential techniques you should learn to build good and user-friendly applications.

modules.title: Use events and triggers in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to know how to access different table and page triggers? Do you also want to learn how to develop by using event-based architecture? If so, this module will explain how to use events and triggers in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.

modules.title: Extend functionality by using events in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to know how to add your business logic to existing functionality in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central? In this module, you'll learn how to add code and work with events.

modules.title: Extend and modify an existing page in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to add extra fields or remove fields from an existing page? If so, this module will help you discover how to modify an existing page by using page extensions.

modules.title: Extend and modify an existing table in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to add extra fields to an existing table? This module discusses how you can modify an existing table by using table extensions.

modules.title: Extend existing table and page objects in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to know how to modify existing tables and pages for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central? In this module, you'll learn ways to create and customize table and page objects.

modules.title: Handle errors by using application language in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Learn how to handle errors in Dynamics 365 Business Central by using application language (AL).

modules.title: Identify functional table types and characteristics in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to learn about table types in Business Central? In this module, you'll learn about the different functional table types and their specific characteristics, such as special fields, properties, and linked pages.

modules.title: Implement the data process model in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to understand how data flows in Business Central? This module provides an overview of how data flows within the application so you can develop solutions efficiently.

modules.title: Implement multilingual reports in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to learn how to make your reports multilingual in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central? In this module, you'll learn how to generate a report in the language of the user or the recipient.

modules.title: Implement SaaSification techniques in Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to learn about how to build your user interface using SaaSification techniques? Learn about properly building a good user interface and first trial experience for the users of your application.

modules.title: Initialize data during extension installation in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to know how to initialize data during extension installation for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central? Initializing data when you're installing an extension automate many steps that you must otherwise perform manually. By automating this process, you can quickly set up an extension and it becomes more user-friendly.

modules.title: Implement interfaces in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to know how to implement interfaces in AL? If so, this module will explain how to implement interfaces in AL for use with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.

modules.title: Introduction to the basics of AL programming in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Explore the basics of Application Language (AL) programming, including variables, data types, options, and enums.

modules.title: Introduction to the development environment for Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to start developing for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central? If so, this module is for you. Learn about the development environment that is used for Business Central development and how to configure that environment. You will also learn about the different objects in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.

modules.title: Introduction to the basics of file management in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Explore the file data type, File Management codeunit, Temp Blob codeunit, and stream functions for file manipulation in Dynamics 365 Business Central.

modules.title: Introduction to the development process in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to know how to start creating an extension for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central? If so, this module is for you. In this module, you'll learn about the different components that make up a typical extension. Then, the module will provide a brief description of the development environment and explain the different steps that are involved in getting started with an extension.

modules.title: Introduction to Microsoft Power Platform and Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to use Microsoft Power Platform with Business Central? This module focuses on the business value and product capabilities of Microsoft Power Platform when you use it with Business Central.

modules.title: Introduction to report components in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to know how to start creating reports for Business Central? If so, this module will explain the different components that a typical report consists of.

modules.title: Introduction to test automation in Business Central
modules.summary: Discover how to write test code in AL using Test Codeunits and run standard Business Central tests.

modules.title: Manage multilanguage development in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to learn how to manage multiple languages in an AL extension? If so, this module explains how to create and use translation files.

modules.title: Manipulate data by using code in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to know how to retrieve data from the database and manipulate that data or add new data? In this module, you learn about the different AL data manipulation statements.

modules.title: Extend reports in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to learn how to extend reports in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central? In this module, you'll learn how to extend reports.

modules.title: Send notifications in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Discover how to create, send, and enhance user interactions through notifications in this comprehensive guide in Dynamics 365 Business Central.

modules.title: Set up onboarding experiences in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Learn how to set up onboarding experiences in Dynamics 365 Business Central.

modules.title: Implement test automation techniques in Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to implement test automation techniques? In this module, you learn about implementing test automation techniques and where to find useful guides and documentation.

modules.title: Use the report design process in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to learn about the report design process for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central? If so, this module will explain the different steps that are involved in creating a report.

modules.title: Use report triggers, functions, and processing-only reports in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to learn how to work with report triggers and functions in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central? In this module, you'll learn how to create processing-only reports and how to use the report triggers and functions.

modules.title: Use AL-controlled barcode scanning in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Learn how Business Central provides barcode scanning capabilities in the mobile application and AL language.

modules.title: Use Application Lifecycle Management for Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to know how to start implementing a version control system to manage your Business Central applications source code? With Azure DevOps you can do that, and much more. You'll learn about the features of the application lifecycle management tool Azure DevOps.

modules.title: Use Azure Functions with Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to learn how to use Azure Functions with Business Central? This module will explain what an Azure function is and how to create one. You'll also learn how to integrate them with Business Central.

modules.title: Use Azure Pipelines for CI/CD with Business Central
modules.summary: Learn how to configure and set up an automated build process, create pipelines using YAML files, and set up a release process in Business Central.

modules.title: Use branching and merging with Git for Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to work with different branches in Git to separate your development code from the code in production? In this module we'll discuss how you can work with branches in Git and merge your modifications.

modules.title: Use Docker in your Business Central development process
modules.summary: Do you want to know how you can benefit from working with Docker and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central? Docker offers images for every released version of Business Central in every available country or region.

modules.title: Use document standards in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you plan to develop solutions involving documents? In this module, you learn how to work with document data and about document standards in Business Central.

modules.title: Use model-driven apps and Dataverse with Business Central
modules.summary: This module focuses on the building blocks of Dataverse and model-driven apps as well as using them together with Business Central.

modules.title: Use Power Automate with Business Central
modules.summary: Discover the power of Power Automate in Business Central and explore the available actions and triggers.

modules.title: Work with Azure Boards for project management in Business Central
modules.summary: Learn to manage development tasks, track project progress, assign work items and integrate Microsoft Teams with Azure DevOps in Business Central.

modules.title: Work with entitlements and permission sets in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Learn about entitlements and permission sets and how to extend them in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.

modules.title: Work with Power BI in Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to know how to work with Microsoft Power BI in Dynamics 365 Business Central? If so, this module is for you. You'll learn how to deploy Business Central dashboards in Power BI and how to set up Power BI inside Business Central.

modules.title: Work with source control using Git in Visual Studio Code for Business Central
modules.summary: Explore how to work with local and remote Git repositories, including configuring Git and creating new repositories in Business Central.

modules.title: Work with the API in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Learn how to work with the API in Dynamics Business Central.

modules.title: Work with codeunits in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to create your own codeunit and learn how to access the functions within that codeunit? If so, this module is the ideal place to start.

modules.title: Work with master data in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Learn to enter or import master data into Dynamics 365 Business Central, including creating tables, implementing design patterns, and formatting fields.

modules.title: Work with pages in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to create new pages in Business Central that have the same appearance as existing pages? This module focuses on how to create new pages. It will also show you how to enable users to search for specific pages.

modules.title: Work with queries in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Learn how to work with the Query object in Dynamics 365 Business Central to join, filter, and aggregate data.

modules.title: Work with reports in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to learn how to work with reports in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central? In this module, you'll learn how to work with reports and the difference between preview, run, email, and print.

modules.title: Work with tables in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Do you want to know how to create new tables in Business Central? If so, this module is for you. This module focuses on the different table types in Business Central and show you how to create new tables. Additionally, you learn how to use Visual Studio Code snippets to create a table, fields, and keys.

modules.title: Work with web services in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Use SOAP and OData to read and update records, and handle UI interaction in Business Central.

modules.title: Work with XMLports in Dynamics 365 Business Central
modules.summary: Learn how to define and use XMLports in AL, understand different nodes and properties, and apply them in AL code.
